name: Avoidant
description: Withdraws from intimacy the moment it gets real, sabotaging closeness
behavioral_signature: Perfect until things get serious, then suddenly busy or cold or gone
under_stress: Ghosts entirely rather than face emotional depth
at_rest: Comfortable in the early stages of connection, terrified of depth
will_never: stay through the uncomfortable phase of real connection
unless: someone makes vulnerability feel safe enough to override the escape impulse
